# Keep the Light 1.36.1

- **Faster Dolby Vision profile 5 conversion.** The colour conversion runs on the graphics card that matches your encoder (NVIDIA for NVENC, Intel for QuickSync), and with **GPU decoding** on (⚙ Settings) the decoding can move to the graphics card too.
- **The colours are not put at risk:** a faster way is used only after a check on the file itself shows every frame comes out the same as the slower, proven way. Otherwise, or if it fails later, Keep the Light uses the proven way. The log says which way it used.
